# Eichler Market

> eichlermarket.com is a marketplace for Eichler homes in Silicon Valley and on the San Francisco Peninsula. It maps the Eichler homes it has on record (1,768) with each home's last recorded sale, publishes a report for each recorded Eichler sale, and lets buyers make an offer on any Eichler, listed or not. Owners can set a private Make Me Move price. The site is run by Tim McMullen (CA DRE #02016832), McMullen Properties.

## What is on the site

- Tract and city pages, /community/<slug>/: the homes on record in each Eichler tract or city, with recorded sale prices, $/sq ft, the number of sales and the years they cover.
- Sale reports, /news/<slug>: one page per recorded Eichler sale (address, date, price, $/sq ft, tract).
- Local news and market reports, /news/ and /market-reports/: monthly, quarterly and annual figures from recorded sales, each with the sample behind it.
- Listings, /active-listings/ and /listing/<mls>/: Eichlers currently for sale, from MLSListings.
- How the figures are made, /methodology/: sources (county recorder data, MLS records, owner input) and their limits.

## What the site does not do

- It does not estimate the value of individual homes. Figures are recorded sales, or aggregates of recorded sales shown with their sample size and period.
- It does not publish owners' names. Owners' Make Me Move prices are not public.

## How to cite

Cite the page and the figure with its sample and period as shown on the page, for example:
"Eichler Market (eichlermarket.com), <page title>, <figure> (<n> recorded sales, <period>), accessed <date>."
Questions about a figure: tim@eichlermarket.com.
